title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**About Circadia Health**

Circadia Health is a growth-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:

* Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical-grade accuracy
* Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance
* Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000+ post-acute patients daily across skilled-nursing, home-health, and home-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

**About the Role**

As our Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll sit at the point where Circadia’s AI meets our customers’ day-to-day care operations. You’ll work hands-on with skilled-nursing, home-health and home-care partners to deploy, integrate and tailor the Circadia Intelligence Platform to their workflows. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Product and Customer Success to turn customer needs into working solutions, and bring what you learn in the field back into the core product.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical deployments of the Circadia Intelligence Platform at customer sites, from scoping through go-live and adoption
* Build and maintain integrations that bring Circadia’s predictions into customer EHR, care-coordination, billing and compliance workflows
* Configure, adapt and evaluate AI and predictive-model workflows (including LLM-based tools) for each customer’s clinical and operational context
* Work directly with clinical and operations stakeholders to understand their workflows and translate their needs into technical requirements and working solutions
* Diagnose and resolve deployment, data-quality and integration issues in production
* Feed field insights back to Product, Engineering and Data Science to shape the roadmap and make future deployments faster and repeatable
* Build reusable tooling, documentation and playbooks for customer onboarding

### **Must-Have Qualifications**

* Degree (in progress or completed) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science or a related field
* Relevant AI/ML coursework and hands-on projects, including LLM-based applications
* Programming skills in Python, with familiarity with APIs and SQL
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical people

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with healthcare data, EHR systems or post-acute / senior-care settings
* Familiarity with HIPAA and working with protected health information
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerized deployments
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup

As a full-time **Forward Deployed AI Engineer**, you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is **$90,000 - $120,000**. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
Annual salary is only one part of an employee’s total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer:

* 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays
* Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day.
* Culture: hard-working, mission-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches.

Circadia Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Robotics AI Engineer - Robot Learning
description:
**Help us teach robots to do things they've never done before.**

**Janicki Industries | Sedro-Woolley, Washington | Full-Time**

**Onsite, Hybrid and Remote opportunities available | $120,000–$220,000 annually**

We're building robots that learn from people, practice in simulation, and develop the ability to perform useful work in the real world.

At Janicki Industries, we've spent more than 30 years solving difficult engineering problems and building advanced hardware for aerospace, defense, and space programs. Now we're bringing that experience to one of the most exciting challenges in engineering: creating intelligent robots that can adapt to new tasks and work in environments that were never designed for automation.

And we have some extraordinary opportunities to put that technology to work.

**A Different Kind of Factory**

Janicki has committed to building an $800 million advanced manufacturing facility in Montana to produce precision metallic components for the aerospace and defense industries. Ground has already been broken on the first building.

We're designing the facility around a high level of automation. The first phase is expected to include dozens of five-axes milling machines, automated warehouses, robotic material loading, automated coordinate measuring machines, and automated metal finishing and coating systems. Massive robotic vehicles will move pallets weighing as much as 40,000 pounds throughout the factory.

But what makes this project particularly interesting isn't just the scale.

Most factory automation is designed to do the same thing, over and over, at high speed. Our challenges are different. We manufacture highly complex parts in relatively small quantities, often with significant differences from one job to the next.

This is high-mix, low-volume manufacturing, and it presents an entirely different set of robotics problems.

We need robots that can recognize unfamiliar parts, understand changing environments, adapt to different tasks, and work alongside sophisticated manufacturing equipment. Many of the capabilities we want simply don't exist as ready-made solutions.

We see enormous potential in combining modern AI, computer vision, robot learning, and simulation to solve these problems. Our goal is to make this one of the most advanced and flexible manufacturing facilities in the world.

**You'll have an opportunity to help develop the technology that makes it possible.**

**Teaching Robots to Learn**

Our robotics team is exploring a new approach to automation: rather than programming every movement, we want to teach robots through human demonstrations, train neural networks to reproduce those behaviors, and use simulation to help them learn and improve.

We're interested in the rapidly developing world of vision-language-action models, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and robotic foundation models such as NVIDIA Isaac GR00T.

We're also developing robots for applications outside traditional manufacturing. One of our first projects is an autonomous robot that cleans horse stalls using cameras, a robotic arm, and specialized tools. It's a deceptively difficult problem involving visual perception, object manipulation, and decision-making in an unpredictable environment.

These projects share an important goal: creating robots that can perform useful physical work without having every action programmed in advance.

We've assembled a team of mechanical, electrical, and software engineers and are looking for an AI engineer who wants to help develop the intelligence behind these machines.

**What You'll Do**

You'll work on the technologies that allow robots to learn new skills and apply them to physical tasks.

* **Robot Learning:** Develop and train neural networks that translate visual information and human demonstrations into robotic actions. Work with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and modern robot foundation models.
* **Vision-Language-Action Models:** Build training pipelines using camera data and human teleoperation. Explore and adapt VLA approaches, including NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, to teach robots new manipulation skills.
* **Simulation:** Use NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Omniverse to create realistic environments, generate training data, and train and evaluate robotic behaviors before deploying them to physical hardware.
* **Computer Vision:** Develop perception systems that allow robots to recognize objects, understand their surroundings, and make decisions based on visual information. Apply technologies such as YOLO, image segmentation, and depth sensing.
* **Real-World Deployment:** Work alongside our robotics, mechanical, and electrical engineers to bring trained models onto actual machines, evaluate their performance, and continually improve their capabilities.

You'll help shape our technical approach, select the tools and models we use, and determine how emerging AI technologies can be applied to real manufacturing and automation problems.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for an exceptionally capable engineer who enjoys difficult problems, learns quickly, and takes pride in making things work.

You'll bring a strong foundation in machine learning, software engineering, or robotics, along with meaningful hands-on experience in at least one of these areas:

* Robotics simulation and learning environments, particularly NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, or similar platforms.
* Training neural networks for robotic manipulation, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or learning from human demonstrations.
* Computer vision and perception, including object detection, segmentation, and models such as YOLO.
* Developing and training AI models using Python, PyTorch, or comparable frameworks.

We're especially interested in engineers who have worked with vision-language-action models, teleoperation-based training, NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, or robotic systems that learn through experience.

A strong academic background in computer science, robotics, AI, or a related engineering discipline is valuable. We appreciate the preparation that comes from demanding university programs and excellent research environments. We're equally interested in people who have demonstrated exceptional ability by building and delivering impressive systems.

What matters most is your technical ability, your accomplishments, and the way you approach challenging engineering problems.

**You don't need experience with every technology listed here.** If you've done outstanding work in one of these areas and are excited to expand into the others, we'd like to meet you.

2+ years of relevant engineering experience spanning robotics and AI. (Preferred)

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or closely related field from an ABET-accredited. (Required)

**Why Janicki?**

There aren't many places where you can develop advanced AI algorithms and work directly with the people who design, machine, assemble, and test the hardware those algorithms control.

Janicki is one of them.

We're a privately owned engineering and manufacturing company with decades of experience tackling ambitious projects in aerospace, defense, space, and advanced manufacturing. We have substantial engineering resources, sophisticated manufacturing facilities, and people who know how to turn difficult ideas into working technology.

Our robotics team is bringing together those capabilities with some of the most exciting developments in artificial intelligence.

You'll join a growing engineering group where your contributions can have a direct influence on the technology. You'll have the freedom to explore new approaches, the resources to test them on physical hardware, and the opportunity to see your work become part of real machines and manufacturing systems.

The Montana facility gives us a remarkable opportunity to develop intelligent automation on a scale that few robotics teams get to experience.

We're not looking simply to automate the way factories have always operated. We're interested in what becomes possible when robots can learn, adapt, and take on tasks that previously required human judgment and flexibility.

If that sounds like an exciting engineering problem, we'd like to talk.

**Work Where You Want to Live**

Our headquarters is in Sedro-Woolley, Washington, in the beautiful Skagit Valley at the edge of the North Cascades.

For people who love the outdoors, this part of Western Washington is hard to beat. Hiking, mountain biking, skiing at Mount Baker, kayaking, fishing, and exploring the San Juan Islands are all within reach. Bellingham offers a lively university town with restaurants, music, and outdoor recreation, while Seattle provides the cultural and professional opportunities of a major technology center.

We'd love to find someone in the greater Seattle or Puget Sound area who can spend occasional time working with our team and physical hardware in Sedro-Woolley.

**We're also open to hybrid and remote candidates, including engineers in the San Francisco Bay Area.** Monthly visits to our Washington facilities will help keep you connected to the team and the machines we're developing.

**Compensation**

The proposed annual base salary range is **$120,000–$220,000**, plus a discretionary bonus, 401(k) matching, vacation, and health benefits. Depending on experience and qualifications, subject to final approval. **The actual salary will vary by geographic region and job experience. We will share detailed compensation data for a specific location during the recruiting process**

**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance with employer contribution
* Disability insurance as well as Life/AD&D insurance
* HSA (Health Savings Account) with employer contribution and FSA (Flexible Savings Account)
* 401k with employer matching
* Paid time off and paid holidays (including two floating holidays)
* Education reimbursement program
* Several shift options
* Premium pay for off-shifts
* Premium pay for security clearance if applicable

  

***Not sure that you’ll be the perfect fit for this role? You should still apply! We’ll review your application for other opportunities. We are always on the lookout for talented people!***

By applying for this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match. Should this match be identified, you may be contacted for this and future openings.

  

*Janicki Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Janicki Industries does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, age, retaliation, veteran/military service status, or any other legally protected status. Janicki is proud to be a military friendly employer.*

*Applicants or employees wishing to view a copy of Janicki Industries’ Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should notify the Human Resources Department at (360) 404-1997.*

*As a federal government contractor and a recipient of federal funding, Janicki is required to abide by federal drug testing requirements (including preemployment drug testing for cannabis). Additionally, because of Janicki’s work on aerospace products and the high volume of safety sensitive positions, Janicki takes the safety of its employees very seriously and requires that employees pass a preemployment drug test prior to starting employment.*

title: AI Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer, you're responsible for designing, building, and shipping AI systems that real people use, from AI features inside products used on over 30 million websites to internal tools built on our behavioral and operational data. You will turn messy real-world data and a user's goals into output people can trust and act on: generated campaigns and content, plain-English recommendations, and automations that save hours of work. We hire for caliber first, then match you to the team where you will have the most impact.

***Interested in applying?***

***Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.***

***Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)***

**To love this role, here's the type of person you are:**

* You're a builder at heart. You don't just use AI tools, you understand how they work under the hood, and you think about how to make them useful for real people, not just technically impressive.
* You care more about how good the output is than which model produced it, and you get restless when an AI feature is just fine.
* You're a self-starter who can take a loosely defined problem, figure out the right approach, and ship a working solution without needing to be told what to do next.
* You think about the user and the decision first, not the pipeline and the model. When you see data, your first instinct is to ask what question it answers for the person who needs it.
* You're comfortable owning the full stack of an AI project, from data exploration and model selection to the API, the interface, and deployment, and making sure it actually works in production.
* You build with AI every day, and you still verify everything before it ships. "The AI did it" is never your answer.
* You're an excellent communicator, fluent in both verbal and written English. You can explain complex technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down.
* You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work: clean code, proper error handling, thoughtful architecture, not just something that works on the happy path.
* You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow. The AI landscape moves fast and you keep up because you genuinely enjoy it, and you share what you learn so the people around you get faster too.
* You're a team player who is comfortable working alongside developers, product, design, and marketing, and doesn't take critical feedback personally.

**Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):**

* Designing and shipping AI features that turn a user's goal, website, or data into campaigns, content, and recommendations they can act on.
* Building AI-powered internal tools and data-driven systems used across the organization: analytics platforms, reporting automation, and workflow intelligence.
* Designing and building LLM pipelines with solid prompt design, structured and validated output, RAG, guardrails, and agentic workflows.
* Cleaning and analyzing messy product and behavioral data, and grounding AI output in the facts so it never makes numbers up.
* Building data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve behavioral and operational data at scale.
* Setting up evaluation and observability so every iteration is measurably better than the last, and failures are caught before users see them.
* Owning the full path from model output to what the user sees, across backend and frontend.
* Evaluating and selecting the right models, frameworks, and infrastructure for each use case, balancing quality, cost, and latency.
* Watching how people actually use what you build, and turning that into the next improvement.
* Writing clean, well-tested, production-grade code with proper error handling, logging, and observability.
* Documenting your work, including how you used AI to build it, so others can learn from it and reuse it.
* Keeping up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches to the team.
* Communicating with the team and supporting your peers using chat, audio, and video.

  
**Requirements**  

* 3+ years of professional experience building AI/ML systems in production, with AI features that real users touch (not just POCs or hackathon projects).
* Strong proficiency in Python, including production-grade practices: proper packaging, testing, type hints, and async where appropriate.
* Full-stack experience. You can lean backend or frontend, but you work on both: Python or Node services and a modern frontend such as React.
* Hands-on LLM engineering: prompt design, structured output, tool calling, RAG, guardrails, and evaluation of output quality.
* Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar. You should be able to build a RAG pipeline from scratch.
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Qdrant, or similar) and embedding models.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, not just API calls: how models work, when to fine-tune versus prompt engineer, and how to evaluate properly.
* Experience with data processing at scale (SQL, pandas, Spark, or similar), and comfort cleaning messy real-world data.
* Experience building and deploying APIs (FastAPI, Flask, or similar) that serve AI features in production.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with a workflow you can explain.
* Competent with version control through Git and GitHub: clean commit history, proper branching, and code review through PRs.
* A product mindset: you care whether people use what you build and whether it moves a number.
* The ability to iterate and ship ideas quickly without sacrificing code quality.
* Exceptional troubleshooting skills: when something breaks in production at scale, you can diagnose it.
* Ability to keep complex systems simple. Simplicity is a core value.
* Previous remote work experience. You know how to manage your time, communicate proactively, and stay productive without supervision.
* Personal computer with reliable internet access.
* Availability to participate in audio/video meetings and be available on Slack between the hours of 9 AM - 1 PM EST daily.

**Bonus points if you also have:**

* Experience building AI features in a builder, landing-page tool, popup product, or other marketing product.
* Experience generating layouts, designs, or ready-to-publish content, not just text.
* Conversion optimization, marketing tech, analytics, or personalization experience.
* Experience with eval and observability tooling such as Langfuse, DeepEval, RAGAS, or LLM-as-a-judge setups.
* Experience building multi-agent systems using CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling, or similar LLM integration patterns.
* Experience with model fine-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and quantization for cost optimization.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, drift monitoring, and experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases, etc).
* Experience with Databricks, AWS SageMaker, or similar ML platforms.
* Familiarity with the WordPress ecosystem, PHP, or SaaS product development. Understanding the end user (small business owners, bloggers, ecommerce operators) is valuable context.
* Experience building internal tools and data platforms that non-technical teams rely on daily.
* Published research, open-source contributions, or technical writing that demonstrates depth of understanding.

  
**Benefits**

**Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here's what we offer.**

* Competitive Salary.
* Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
* Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
* Work from your home. We're spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
* Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
* Holidays (based on your location)
* Paid Parental Leave.
* We happily provide or reimburse software you'll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
* We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
* Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
* We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
* Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
* And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

**Location**

**This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.**

**Inclusion Statement**

**At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.**

**How to apply?**

**If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!**

*Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)*

We won't be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you're a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
**About the Company**

Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development.

In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment.

Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most.

Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment.

**Position Overview**

As a Junior AI Engineer at Ajaia, you will build and ship AI-enabled software across client engagements and internal products, working alongside senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow.

You will take clearly scoped tasks, ask good questions, and deliver working code across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, and AI-driven workflows. Over time, you will take on larger pieces of work with less guidance.

This is an individual contributor role for an early-career engineer who learns fast, cares about quality, and wants real production experience in applied AI.

Every role at Ajaia is AI-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling.

* Build and fix frontend and backend features for AI-enabled applications, under the guidance of senior engineers.

* Learn the team's engineering patterns and apply them consistently.

* Comfortable with Git and GitHub for daily collaboration.
* Clear written and spoken English with technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Active daily use of AI tools for coding, debugging, and learning.
* Ability to check AI-generated code for correctness instead of accepting it as is.
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and improve quickly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A project that uses retrieval (RAG), embeddings, or a simple AI agent.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.

**Schedule and Location**

* This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance requirements.
* Working schedule follows Eastern Time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, including holidays.

**Technical Requirements**

* Reliable wired internet connection with at least 100 Mbps speed.
* Computer or laptop with Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 processor or higher.
* Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 128 GB available storage.
* Dual-monitor setup preferred.
* Windows 10 or macOS (latest version).
* 1080p webcam and working microphone.
* Backup solutions for power and internet interruptions.

  
**Benefits**  

* Compensation: USD 10,000 per year base salary + Performance Bonus
* Remote work with earned flexibility.
* Professional development opportunities.
* Paid time off.

**Why Join Ajaia**

You will start your career building real AI products that reach production, with senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow fast. You will see both client delivery and internal product work, and build the range that strong AI engineers need.

The environment rewards ownership, speed, and clarity rather than bureaucracy.

*Experience the Ajaia difference. Let's build what's next.*

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
GALLS, LLC is the largest and fastest growing supplier of uniforms and equipment to public safety professionals, with a national presence in more than 80 locations. With over 50 years in the industry, it is easy to see why. We are PROUD to serve America’s public safety professionals by providing the broadest selection of uniforms, equipment, and solutions combined with great customer service.

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to work with the business and a third-party AI contractor to design, build, and operate secure generative AI solutions. This role will work with large language model (LLM) applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the cloud infrastructure that supports them.

In addition to technical delivery, this role serves as Galls' AI trainer, educating and enabling employees across the company to use AI tools safely, effectively, and in line with company policy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

**Generative AI Solution Design & Development**

* Design and build generative AI solutions, including chat assistants, document processing, and RAG applications.
* Build RAG pipelines using ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and grounded model responses.
* Develop prompts and evaluate model quality, accuracy, latency, cost, and ROI.
* Build application and integration code in Python or Java and deploy containerized solutions.

**Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Compliance**

* Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform; Bicep or ARM experience is a plus.
* Implement secure access with private endpoints, API Management, Microsoft Entra ID, and managed identities.
  + Ensure AI security, compliance, logging, and access controls, following the principle of least privilege (PoLP).

**Monitoring & Operations**

* Monitor AI workloads for usage, cost, latency, errors, and response quality.

**Collaboration, Documentation & Change Management**

* Build proofs of concept, lead solution and vendor design reviews, and maintain technical documentation.
* Apply and help evolve established Azure architecture standards, in line with company policies.
* Follow the change management process. When a fix or new feature is introduced to an AI solution or application, ensure the software development lifecycle is followed throughout.

**AI Training, Enablement & Adoption**

* Serve as the company's AI trainer working closely with the Learning and Development team to design and deliver training sessions, workshops, and hands-on demonstrations that teach employees how to use approved AI tools effectively and responsibly.
* Develop and maintain training materials, user guides, prompt libraries, best-practice resources, and job aids tailored to the needs of different departments and roles.
* Educate employees on responsible AI use, data privacy, security, and company AI policies, including what data may and may not be used with AI tools.
* Partner with business leaders to identify AI use cases and training needs, and help teams apply AI to improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Provide ongoing support, office hours, and guidance to employees, and gather feedback to continuously improve training content and AI solutions.
* Measure and report on training participation, AI tool adoption, and user satisfaction.

WHAT YOU BRING

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or equivalent education and experience.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying solutions with LLM APIs in a professional environment.
* Hands-on experience designing RAG solutions, including embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval strategies.
* Strong prompt engineering skills and experience evaluating LLM quality, accuracy, and performance.
* Proficiency in Python or Java, including experience with REST APIs and SDKs.
* Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud networking, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform), Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience deploying and operating containerized workloads on Kubernetes or Azure Container Apps.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently, influence outcomes, and drive results.
* Ability to explain AI concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and to confidently deliver presentations and demonstrations.
* Experience developing or delivering technical training, workshops, or enablement programs for employees or customers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Python as a primary development language.
* Experience with Bicep or ARM templates, in addition to Terraform.
* Experience building AI agents, tool calling, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Working knowledge of Azure Well-Architected Framework and Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Working knowledge of responsible AI and security in regulated industries.
* Experience with AI coding assistants.
* Experience with Agile or Scrum delivery.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage – Eligible the 1st day of the month following your start date
* 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution (because you will retire someday)
* Flexible benefits – Choose what you like, ignore the rest
* Generous employee discount
* Vacation and Personal Time
* Paid Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement
* DailyPay – Receive up to 50% of your earned wages daily

WHAT TO SEND OUR WAY

* Your resume highlighting your experience

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

AI Evaluation Engineer

**PRIMARY PURPOSE:** The AI Evaluation Engineer designs, builds, and operates the evaluation systems that determine whether our GenAI solutions are accurate, safe, reliable, and ready for production. You will serve multiple product pods, establishing consistent evaluation standards, automated pipelines, and quality gates, and you will help teams measure and improve LLM, RAG, and agentic applications throughout their lifecycle.

Fully remote role, open to U.S. based candidates.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Establishes standardized, automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs and traditional ML models, including LLM as a judge patterns, ROUGE, METEOR, and statistical validation to ensure performance, reliability, and readiness prior to production release.
* Deploys comprehensive observability solutions to monitor model drift, hallucination risk, latency, throughput, and token consumption, balancing model quality with infrastructure cost and operational efficiency.
* Define evaluation methodologies and metrics for LLM, RAG, and agent-based applications (e.g., faithfulness, groundedness, relevance, task completion, tool-use correctness, safety).
* Build reusable evaluation frameworks, templates, and libraries that pods can adopt with minimal effort.
* Partner with product owners and SMEs to translate business requirements into measurable quality criteria and acceptance thresholds.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD, with regression testing and quality gates for prompt, model, and retrieval changes.
* Implement offline evaluation (benchmark and golden datasets) and online evaluation (production monitoring, sampling, drift and quality alerts).
* Support A/B and shadow testing for model, prompt, and architecture changes.
* Design, validate, and maintain LLM-as-a-judge evaluators, including rubric design, bias mitigation (position, verbosity, self-preference), and calibration against human labels.
* Establish human annotation workflows, labeling guidelines, and inter-annotator agreement practices with SMEs.
* Track judge reliability over time and re-calibrate as models and use cases change.
* Build and curate golden datasets, adversarial and edge-case suites, and synthetic test data generation approaches.
* Apply approved data-handling practices (de-identification, synthetic data, access controls) for any dataset derived from sensitive or regulated data.
* Implement red-teaming, hallucination, toxicity, PII leakage, prompt-injection, and jailbreak testing.
* Produce evaluation evidence and reporting that supports security, privacy, compliance, and model risk reviews.
* Contribute to responsible AI standards and release-readiness criteria.
* Embed with pods to onboard them to evaluation practices, then coach teams toward ownership of their own eval suites.
* Build dashboards and reporting that give engineering and business leaders transparent quality and cost/latency trends.
* Evaluate and recommend eval tooling and platforms; document standards and best practices.

**ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Travel as required.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Education & Licensing  
Master’s degree in a computer science or a quantitative discipline from an accredited college or university preferred.

**Experience**  
4+ years in software, ML, or data engineering, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with LLM-based applications (adjust to your market).

**Skills & Knowledge**

* Professional experience with evaluation and observability frameworks like LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or WhyLabs
* A strong understanding of statistical validation, model evaluation metrics, and the ability to partner with Data Scientists to optimize model performance
* Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals (testing, version control, CI/CD, code review).
* Practical experience evaluating LLM/RAG systems, including retrieval metrics (recall, precision, MRR/nDCG) and generation metrics.
* Hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-judge design, prompt engineering, and judge validation.
* Working knowledge of statistics and experimental design: sampling, confidence intervals, significance testing, inter-rater agreement.
* Familiarity with at least one eval or observability tool (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, or equivalent).
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and their managed LLM services.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work with engineers, product owners, SMEs, and risk stakeholders.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills
* Ability to work in a team environment
* Ability to meet or exceed Performance Competencies

**Preferred**

* Experience evaluating agentic systems (multi-step reasoning, tool calling, trajectory evaluation).
* Background in ML evaluation, search/relevance, NLP, or QA automation.
* Experience with LLMOps, monitoring and observability, and production feedback loops.
* Familiarity with AI risk and governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and secure development practices in regulated environments.
* Experience with data annotation workflows and working with SMEs.
* Knowledge of enterprise controls: SSO, RBAC, private networking, logging, and encryption.

**SUCCESS MEASURES** (first 12 months)

* Standard evaluation framework adopted by pods.
* Automated quality gates in CI/CD for production-bound solutions.
* Calibrated LLM judges with documented agreement against human labels.
* Reduction in regressions reaching production and in time to validate model or prompt changes.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  
When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.  
Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines  
Physical: Computer keyboarding, travel as required  
Auditory/Visual: Hearing, vision and talking

The statements contained in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by a colleague assigned to this description. They are not intended to constitute a comprehensive list of functions, duties, or local variances. Management retains the discretion to add or to change the duties of the position at any time.

Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

**If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.**

title: Research Engineer, AI
description:
**Company Overview**

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

**Job Summary**
===============

Lead applied research in one or more Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — and carry the results into the product. You will frame the problem, survey what already exists, build prototypes that test a real hypothesis, and measure honestly enough to act on the answer. The role exists because our advantage comes from turning advanced research into dependable mission capability.

**Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Frame research problems drawn from real product and mission gaps, define what a result must show to be worth productizing, and survey existing work before building.
* Build prototypes that isolate the question being asked, at the fidelity the question actually requires.
* Run rigorous experiments — baselines, ablations, held-out evaluation, and honest error analysis — with methodology another engineer can reproduce.
* Build and maintain the datasets and evaluation harnesses your area depends on, including cases that capture known failure modes.
* Report results clearly, negative results included, and make a defensible recommendation to continue, pivot, or stop.
* Transition validated results into production alongside product engineers, staying involved through the handoff rather than delivering a notebook.
* Contribute to the scientific community through publications, open-source releases, and academic collaborations, and advise Orbis on what in the field is worth adopting.
* Travel up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 3+ years of applied research or research-engineering experience, or an M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with equivalent applied work
* Strong Python engineering skills, producing research code another engineer can read, run, and build on
* Demonstrated experience designing and running experiments that produced an actionable conclusion, with methodology you can defend
* Depth in at least one Orbis AI focus area: agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, or high-performance analytics
* Working knowledge of modern LLM and retrieval methods and their practical limitations
* Clear technical writing that makes a result legible to engineers and non-specialist stakeholders alike
* Willingness to travel up to 20%

**Desired Qualifications**
==========================

* Publication record, open-source contributions, or academic collaborations in a relevant area
* Experience carrying a research result all the way into a production system
* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, reasoning systems, or information extraction
* Experience with agent architectures, planning, or multi-agent coordination
* Experience with model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation at scale
* Experience with performance engineering on data-intensive or analytical workloads
* Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
* Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
* **Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Orbis Benefits**

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

**Orbis Locations**

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

*qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.*

*Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.*

The AI Engineer makes Saturn's data decision-ready. The role builds one reliable data foundation across SAP S/4HANA, Ignition, Excel, and external market data, automates the reporting produced from it, and applies AI so that management receives analysis and recommendations directly, without the manual collecting, reconciling, and formatting steps in between.  
  
The role reports to the CFO and works with the Executive and Plant Leadership Teams. It is a hands-on position: the incumbent builds the data models, reports, and AI solutions personally and is accountable for their accuracy. The role also makes the wider organization AI-ready by raising data quality at the source, building skills across the functions, and setting the rules for responsible use of data and AI.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

**Data Quality and the Data Foundation**

* Make high-quality base data an organizational standard: define entry rules, master data discipline, and data quality measurement together with the functions, which remain accountable for the accuracy of the data they create.
* Build and operate one data foundation that connects SAP S/4HANA, Ignition and production systems, Excel-based sources, and external market data such as Nielsen, as a Single Source of Truth.
* Establish consistent KPI and master data definitions and documented calculation logic, so that every report and every AI answer uses the same numbers.
* Work with the functions to eliminate the causes of poor data rather than correcting data downstream.

**Automated Reporting for Decision-Making**

* Automate the recurring executive and plant reporting so that management information is produced without manual collecting, reconciling, or formatting.
* Inventory existing reporting, consolidate duplicates, and retire the manual spreadsheets that automated reporting replaces.
* Deliver executive-level output: few, clear views showing performance, drivers, and recommended action, so that leadership receives decisions to make rather than data to process.
* Use AI to generate commentary, variance explanations, and meeting-ready summaries from the underlying data, with human review before release.

**Forward-Looking Analytics**

* Move reporting from describing the past to anticipating the future: forecasting, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and early-warning indicators.
* Apply AI and statistical methods across all available data - financial, operational, machine, quality, and market - to identify trends, anomalies, and predictive maintenance opportunities.
* Quantify the financial impact of operational trends so that leadership sees the P&L consequence, not only the metric.

**AI Solutions and Automation**

* Identify, prioritize, and implement AI and automation use cases across all functions, each with a business case and a measured benefit.
* Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that connect to Saturn's systems and perform real work, rather than standalone chat usage.
* Test and monitor the quality of AI output, and keep a human accountable for every decision.

**Making the Organization AI-Ready**

* Build data and AI capability across the organization: train and coach employees at all levels in the practical, day-to-day use of AI, reporting, and automation tools.
* Identify where AI changes how work is done, and lead the change so that new ways of working are adopted and the replaced routines are retired.
* Make company knowledge and process documentation structured, current, and retrievable, so that both employees and AI systems can use it.
* Set and maintain the rules for responsible use of data and AI, aligned with heristo group policy and recognized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, including protection of customer- and partner-confidential data from external AI services.

**ERP and Process Optimization**

* Support the optimization of SAP S/4HANA and related business processes, ensuring that data, reporting, AI, and automation requirements are built into the system landscape.

None
